pstack-verifier: PASS+NOTES @ 82c397008dbf9de5b2173cb4555b321172526cd4

Verified by DeepSeek (deepseek-flash), a different model family from the author, on a GitHub-hosted runner. It read the diff and text evidence only, never screenshots.

The diff adds a Pi model list, a Model section in the attach sheet, a set_model host request and a /model shortcut, with JVM tests for parsing, the host request and load/retry concurrency; nothing in the diff obviously breaks a promised outcome. However, both driven journeys ran Claude sessions only, so no evidence shows the Pi picker, the live model fetch, the set_model switch or the error/retry states actually working.

Journeys driven (parent is the app before this change, head is after):
- `native-skills.md` parent: passed, head: passed
- `session-reader.md` parent: passed, head: passed

Evidence:
- Journey native-skills.md passed on both parent and head; the head transcript ends with NATIVE_SKILLS_MODEL_EFFORT_PROVEN and receipts include '/model sonnet', so the existing Claude Model/Effort menu still works after the attach-sheet changes.
- Journey session-reader.md passed on both parent and head with 'FEATURE VERIFIED: session-reader.md' and VERIFY_INTERRUPTED_528, showing no regression in the non-Claude attach menu or reader send/enter/interrupt flow.
- Both journeys' fixture-start.txt files show a 'Claude Code' console, so neither run ever opened a Pi chat where the new Model row would appear.
- The head app-source-sha in both journeys (e235eea) matches the head revision.txt, so the artifacts come from the changed build.
- The PR description states 'No emulator run proved a live Pi chat switching models', matching the absence of any Pi journey in the evidence.
- New JVM tests PiModelsTest and SessionPiModelsLoadTest cover request/parse/set_model JSON, empty and failed loads and a blocked second load, but their execution result is not present in the evidence.

Not covered:
- The plus button showing a Model row in a Pi chat, and whether it is reachable directly or only inside a host submenu.
- A live fetch of Pi's model list from the server and the loading/empty/failure rows with tap-to-retry.
- Tapping a model sending the set_model request and the running Pi chat actually switching to it (plus the success/failure toast).
- Typing /model in a Pi chat opening the same model sheet.
- That the set_model body matches what desktop sends (IGSH-2275) against a real host, not just the unit test's expectation.
- Whether the added JVM tests pass in CI.

Run: https://github.com/valentinyeo/multiprompt-android/actions/runs/43714002019
